name: OPNsense
description: Imports the OPNsense firewall (version) and its interfaces with address, subnet and VLAN into the knowledge graph and gives AI clients the DHCP leases and gateway status. Settings: url (e.g. https://fw.example.org), key and secret (API key of a user with read-only access to Diagnostics, Interfaces, DHCP and Gateways), optional name (default: OPNsense).

mcpTools.name: opnsense.sync
mcpTools.description: Import the firewall and its interfaces into the knowledge graph now.

mcpTools.name: opnsense.leases
mcpTools.description: Current DHCPv4 leases: address, MAC, hostname, interface and state.

mcpTools.name: opnsense.gateways
mcpTools.description: Gateways with status, delay and packet loss.
